label: hvac_or_thermal_issue
title: AC failure: room overheating to 34.5 C (KH building, level 03)
expl: The room is heating because cooling stopped, not because of a second heat source. Inspect the AC.

label: hvac_or_thermal_issue
title: Room overheating, AC not cooling: KH building, level 03
expl: The room is genuinely warming (34.5 C, 33.5 C on the AC sensor). Check the AC units.

label: hvac_or_thermal_issue
title: AC cooling lost, room warming to 34.5 C: KH building, level 03
expl: An empty room cannot self-cool: the AC stopped and the room is warming.

label: hvac_or_thermal_issue
title: Room temperature 34.5 C, AC not cooling (KH building, level 03)
expl: The room and the AC unit sensor both warm, but the AC units stopped, so the room is the cause: check the AC.

label: hvac_or_thermal_issue
title: Real room heat: 34.5 C (critical): KH building, level 03
expl: The room is genuinely heating: two independent sensors agree. The AC units are off and the room is unoccupied, so the wall is absorbing heat.

label: hvac_or_thermal_issue
title: Room temperature 34.5 C, real or sensor fault (KH building, level 03)
expl: Real: the room and the unit that serves it warm together. Check the AC and reschedule.

label: hvac_or_thermal_issue
title: AC cooling lost, room warming (KH building, level 03)
expl: Two independent readings agree: the room is heating up because the AC stopped.

label: hvac_or_thermal_issue
title: Room temperature step, over the critical limit: KH building, level 03
expl: Real heat: the AC stopped and the room is warming. Inspect the AC.

label: hvac_or_thermal_issue
title: AC stopped, room temperature 34.5 C and rising: KH building, level 03
expl: The room is genuinely heating up because the AC stopped. Check the AC controller.

label: hvac_or_thermal_issue
title: Room heating after AC shutdown (KH building, level 03)
expl: Two independent sensors agree: the room warms after the AC stopped. The AC sensor now reads lower, which explains it.

label: hvac_or_thermal_issue
title: Room temperature 34.5 C, AC stopped (KH building, level 03)
expl: The AC unit sensor is lower because its unit is turned off; the room is cooling below it.

label: hvac_or_thermal_issue
title: Room heating to 34.5 C after AC shutdown (KH building, level 03)
expl: Real heat from an AC failure: an empty room cannot warm on its own. Check the AC units.

label: hvac_or_thermal_issue
title: Room temperature 34.5 C, AC sensor lower: KH building, level 03
expl: The room is heating even though the AC unit sensor is lower: the room is the larger evidence and it is outside the AC unit.

label: hvac_or_thermal_issue
title: Room temperature 34.5 C, AC units off: KH building, level 03
expl: Two independent sensors agree: the room is heating up even though it is empty and the AC units are off. Check for a new heat source.

label: hvac_or_thermal_issue
title: AC units stopped, room temperature 34.5 C: KH building, level 03
expl: The AC units stopped and the room they serve is heating. Stop them and re-check.

label: hvac_or_thermal_issue
title: Room heating failing (AC units stopped) (KH building, level 03)
expl: The AC units stopped and the room is heating up with it (34.5 C). Check the AC units.

label: hvac_or_thermal_issue
title: Room overheating after AC shutdown (KH building, level 03)
expl: The room is heating because cooling stopped. The AC sensor agrees, so the heat is real.

label: hvac_or_thermal_issue
title: Room temperature step 2.0 C at 15:20, AC stopped: KH building, level 03
expl: The room is genuinely heating (two independent sensors agree). Check the AC.

label: hvac_or_thermal_issue
title: Room heating without AC cooling (KH building, level 03)
expl: Two independent readings agree: the AC stopped and the room is heating. Inspect the AC units.

label: sensor_fault
title: Room temperature sensor reads 34.5 C but the room is empty (KH building, level 03)
expl: Do not read 34.5 C as real heat: one sensor disagrees with the AC room sensor and nothing else shows warmth.

label: hvac_or_thermal_issue
title: AC cooling lost, room and AC sensor warming: KH building, level 03
expl: The AC sensor warms because the AC stopped and the room is heating; the sensor itself is not the cause.

label: hvac_or_thermal_issue
title: Real warming: room temperature step then rising, beyond 34 (KH building, level 03)
expl: The room temperature is real and the room is heating up; watch it.

label: hvac_or_thermal_issue
title: AC cooling lost, room 34.5 C: KH building, level 03
expl: The AC is not cooling. Check it before it damages the room.

label: hvac_or_thermal_issue
title: Room overheating, critical 34.5 C: KH building, level 03
expl: The room is genuinely heating: two separate sensors agree and power to the AC dropped. Check the AC units.
